text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I wonder if the protagonist who 
leaped into the dragon's lair is going to 
be all right...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you mean fantasy novels, right? You 
were reading them all day in the dorm 
lobby yesterday too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My father, who works at a bookstore, 
recommended it to me, but honestly, I 
never expected it to resonate with me this 
deeply.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Watching them fight so valiantly to 
fulfill their duty as a knight...! I can't 
help but feel profound empathy and 
respect!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, a mission... That's a massive thing 
to carry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"We have a mission, too. I will... ensure 
victory is carried out."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The presence of a true professional— I can 
sense your steadfast resolve to walk a 
challenging path.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. A path of hardship might not be quite 
right. Sure, we walk carrying a heavy 
burden, but it doesn't feel painfully 
difficult to me. Right, Kris?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Agreed—Precious outweighs pain. That is 
why... I can walk any path.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Seeing the dedication of you 
both truly braces my resolve."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I, too, will forge ahead on my own path— 
the path of a loyal knight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—We must do our best. Everyone has their 
own mission to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's both do our best for what 
matters most to us!
